lines.en: Son of a bee!
Looks like the party already started.
Let me just turn this off.
Who with you?
I see a cute girl, and she's definitely queer.
Oh, I think you're wrong.
She smiled at me.
You have such a reductive understanding of the spectrum of--
Damn it!
Bankruptcy, prison, I'm infertile.
This latte is a delight.
Freddie needs to learn that it's besties before testies.
We could go on a sunset hike, make flower crowns, go skinny dipping.
Sprained ankle, poison ivy, penis parasite.
Mark, is there a little thespian in here who misses her mommy?
Neat!
Oh, you said thespian.
How'd you know that was him?
Oh, he looks like the kind of guy who used to wear his backpack with one strap.
Ooh, you trying to strap him, baby?
Your euphemisms confuse me, but maybe.
